hook: At Copenhagen Business School, interactions matter more than a formal title.

sections.voiceover: At Copenhagen Business School, interactions matter more than a formal title.

Researchers at Copenhagen Business School found leadership emerges through constant team engagement. Mary Uhl-Bien and Anders Trillingsgaard studied how these dynamic patterns shift. Who actually leads when the boss leaves?
University of Warwick researchers explored virtual team meetings in Turkey.

Researchers analyzed 5 hours of video-recorded virtual team meetings in Turkey. Copenhagen Business School published an article featuring Mary Uhl-Bien and Anders Trillingsgaard. Copenhagen Business School highlighted Mary Uhl-Bien and Anders Trillingsgaard discussing collective leadership.
